description: Berger Paints India Limited manufactures and sells paints for home, professional, and industrial users in India and internationally. The company offers interior wall coatings, including designer finishes, interior emulsions, and ceiling paints; exterior wall coatings comprising exterior emulsions and textures, and roof and floor coatings; specialty industrial coatings; putty and cement paints; solvent, interior, exterior, metal, and wood primers; waterproofing solutions; wood finishes; enamels; aerosol spray paints, and DIY kits and stickers.
